notes.title: Update Notes 11/5/2021
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Hello players!
[/b][/h1]

Its been a very long time without any notice, for that all of you have my deepest and sincerest apologies. I have every intention on finishing Allied Nations, I won't go into detail but I will say I have suffered from some physical and mental health issues which along with my hiring of a new staff member falling through had severely delayed the project.

For now this update gives all of you the latest game engine update of 514 which should bring with it many fixes to the launcher, as well the launcher has been reset to a basic look while I invest my time into redesigning the launcher.

[olist]
[u][*] Updates internal game engine to 514
[*] Restores the launcher to a very basic form[/u]
[/olist]

notes.title: Allied Nations Update #5.1
notes.notes:
Hello Gamers

We have had to release a hotfix which will fix an issue where some work in progress interface development was showing upon game start. This was not a game breaking issue but assumed it was likely very annoying. Have a wonderful week.

notes.title: Allied Nations Update #5
notes.notes:
This update begins to set the stage for the v0.3.0 update which will include the political system allowing players to take control of their respective AI nation. Please stand by.

[h1]Changelog[/h1]
[list]
[*] 1.Fixes an issue where door ownership could get removed on restarts.
[*] 2.Fixes an issue with cooking not being restricted to the chef job.
[*] 3.Fixes an issue with pathfinding around tree saplings.
[*] 4.Begining of research extension to add ability to research new structure types.
[*] 5.New AI political stockpile, all NPCs can access of a particular faction.(Work towards v0.3.0)
[*] 6.Slightly boosts the multiplier for wall quality based on building skill.
[*] 7.Fixes a rare issue with units randomly committing suicide with full moods.
[*] 8.Upgrade to the engine version in use which includes some performance enhancements.(Thank you Lummox JR)
[*] 9.Fixes an issue where long running game sessions could crash.
[*] 10.Begins work on a minimap feature by popular player request.
[/list]

notes.title: Allied Nations Update #4
notes.notes:
Sorry for the extended delay on this update, I ended up catching the flu this season and am still recovering(nearly over it). Please enjoy the update as you will now be able to enjoy slavery better than ever.

[h1]Changelog[/h1]
[list]
[*] 1.A few changes to NPC AI to remove AI use of stairs until Z level pathing is implemented.
[*] 2.Fixes to several item release/gather bugs and patches to related exploits.
[*] 3.When researching farming you now can unlock trench digging as well.(Research this again if you have already to unlock the new tech)
[*] 4.Fixes to NPC slaves.(New type of slavery system under the hood.)
[*] 5.Fixes for blueprints not being destroyed on relog.
[*] 6.Fixes an exploit where flying races can land on water.
[*] 7.Fixes an exploit where units can move and set multiple traps at once as if they have telepathy.
[*] 8.Fixes the sometimes mix up where werewolf powers would enact at night rather than day.
[*] 9.Enables Aggressive AI behavior for player units.(NPC Human Alliance are not aggressive and will not attack player units on sight.)
[*] 10.Fixes an issue with AI units not attacking other NPC units they should hate.
[/list]

notes.title: Allied Nations Update #3
notes.notes:
Happy belated holidays!

I bring to you a pretty significant sized bugfixing update with some tweaks to racial stats and some other bonuses please enjoy,

The latest changes have moved to the stable branch and are now in effect. This will cause the loss of your previous saves upon update.

[h1]Changelog[/h1]
[list]
[*] 1.Many more fixes to pathfinding.
[*] 2.Fixes for units whos job is not a certain task trying to do that task anyways.
[*] 3.Balancing for NPCs having OP trap evasion.
[*] 4.Fixes to skeletons.
[*] 5.Fixes to wolf AI
[*] 6.Fixes to Slime AI.
[*] 7.Balancing to racial stats and leveling.
[*] 8.Server start performance optimizations.
[*] 9.Fixes for slaves always staying depressed.
[*] 10.Exploit fix for cages and traps.
[*] 11.Graphical FPS drops caused by Bamboo is fixed.
[*] 12.Fix for mapsaving broken weather graphical effect.
[*] 13.Added godmode command for admins to make all current units invulnerable.(Please enjoy Sandman)
[*] 14.Goblins now have a special ability when dealing with heads.
[*] 15.You can bury your dead if you have a spade.
[*] 16.Crafted items will now decay.
[*] 17.Fixes to the necromancer staff and making skeletons.
[*] 18.New tile sprites for the swamp, grass, and bamboo
[*] 19.NPC army spawns have been reduced to one per month rather then one three times per day.(No more 5000 orcs in a single day on the map, this was mostly for development stress testing.)
[*] 20.Updated to the latest stable byond engine revision.
[/list]

notes.title: Allied Nations Update #2
notes.notes:
A new update for Allied Nations for new years.
I have also added a new branch you can opt into called bleedingedge
to gain access you must enter this code IALSOLIKETOLIVEDANGEROUSLY
under the games beta code.section. Happy Holidays!

CAUTION THE LATEST UPDATE WILL BREAK SAVE COMPATABILITY STAY ON THE STABLE BRANCH IF YOU DO NOT WISH TO LOSE YOUR SAVE.

[h1]Changelog[/h1]
[list]
[*] 1.Fixes to Unit pathfinding in rare instances.
[*] 2.Fixes double clicking units causing them to stop their task.
[*] 3.Fixes for various issues when interacting with certain objects.
[*] 4.AI pathing performance improvements.(10000 units map wide fighting and moving showing only 41% CPU usage in previous version hope to see further scalability with this improvement)
[*] 5.Minor bugfixes to the UI.(Spelling mistakes and other such minor errors)
[*] 6.Made window resizing more responsive.
[*] 7.Added a hosting button to the UI to make hosting easier to understand.
[*] 8.Added a separate UI button to control fullscreen/windowed options.
[*] 9.Breaking saves is inevitable with this update.
[/list]

notes.title: Allied Nations Update #1
notes.notes:
[h1]Changelog[/h1]
[list]
[*] 1.Steam hosted servers now give the default user full admin on launch.
[*] 2.Stability improvements.
[*] 3.Updated backend for increased performance.

notes.title: Steam Early Access Release
notes.notes:
Allied Nations has now been released into Steam Early Access please report any bugs you might find in the official Discord or on the Steam Forums..

Discord:https://discord.gg/tjHJWwb

notes.title: Steam Beta Update #6
notes.notes:
[h1]Changelog[/h1]

1.Made it easier to place selection areas around trees.
2.Fixes for the UI updating when certain objects are interacted with.
3.Fixed some issues with the build menu and the way it handles data at runtime.
4.Made spider stairs work differently then humanoid stairs(Can now build on dirt/grass).
5.Map Saves no longer cause any delay.(Even for very large maps.)
6.Changed the method in which objects move in the world.(This is for future features.(POW))
7.Provided a major fix to items being updated in the modern inventory UI.(Will be much more responsive and should fix any issues from before.)
8.A few optimizations to the way torches function.
9.Items will now properly drop according to the direction you are facing.
10.Beginning of the implementation of job priorities.(This means a unit will be able to have more then one job. This feature will not be complete until version 0.3.0 at minimum.)
11.Changes and fixes to many sounds.
12.Reduction of the games download size.
13.Port 30301 is the default hosting port please make sure this is open for hosting local and live games.

notes.title: Steam Beta Update #5
notes.notes: Letting everyone know about the shadow update that proceded #4. This was a fix to the client that resulted in a white screen being displayed rather then the launcher. This was addressed in the update.

notes.title: Beta Steam Update #4
notes.notes:
Another update for all of you with pre early access beta keys. I hope you enjoy.
[h1]Change Log[/h1]
[list]
[*] 1.Added silk floors and bridges for spiders.
[*] 2.Fixed for some runtime errors.
[*] 3.Removes respawns for armies to reduce rate of NPC population increase.(Not sure why I made army NPCs respawn in the first place.)
[*] 4.Changed initial wood and seed cap to reflect other caps.
[*] 5.Fixed an issue with trees sometimes having the auto selection deleted right before it has finished being destroyed.
[*] 6.Fixed an issue where units who already were below 0 exhaustion would no longer auto sleep.
[*] 7.Added support for spiders and dragons auto sleeping.
[*] 8.Massive decrease in server side CPU usage during extra long hosting sessions.
[*] 9.Added needed resources to building menu descriptions.(Long needed.)
[*] 10.Enabled the destroy tool, reclaim those resources!(You can access it from the build menu)
[*] 11.The server/client is now LAA which should help in some cases for long server run times.
[/list]

notes.title: Beta Steam Update #3
notes.notes:
Another update for all of you with pre early access beta keys. I hope you enjoy.
[h1]Change Log[/h1]
[list]
[*] 1.Fixed an issue where switching to certain jobs would break the mining job till a relog.
[*] 2.Fixes an issue where you can only set certain jobs one unit at a time rather then for all selected.
[*] 3.Crafting now properly only has units set to that job type go work on the job.
[*] 4.Internal improvements to crafting in preparation for a crafting GUI
[*] 5.Major fix to crafting where a crafted item would not get a quality level.
[*] 6.Fixes for spiders breeding.
[*] 7.Fixes to cages and removing a units items while its in a cage.
[*] 8.Improvements and fixes to NPC guarding AI.
[*] 9.Balancing changes to fishing as well as initial fishing and bone cap set to 250.
[*] 10.Fishing now gives 1 cooked fish and 1 bone per successful attempt.
[*] 11.Intelligence now effects experience gains.
[*] 12.You can now toggle a classic style stat menu with the options menu.
[/list]

notes.title: Beta Steam Update #2
notes.notes:
Development is steaming along with several updates for server side and single player gaming. Addition of a secondary style UI known as classic available under the options menu. Major fixes to NPC AI and improvements to NPC guarding AI logic. 

Balancing to fishing and a limiter for initial resources gained through fishing 'Later on you will be able to research improvements to fishing tech and equip better fishing equipment to your units.`. 

Furthermore intelligence now plays a factor in a units skill gains equation. Beyond this I am currently working on other adjustments to balance game play through long play testing. 

I hope everyone participating in this early access beta are able to enjoy it. If you need help I would love to personally assist you and can be DMed on the public discord. https://discord.gg/tjHJWwb
